literal: Producing and, collecting and, protecting and, the protected distributing and, capable is the king.
translation: A true king is capable of creating sources of wealth, collecting it, protecting it, and properly distributing what has been protected.
modern: பொருள் வரும் வழிகளை உருவாக்குவதும், பொருளைச் சேர்ப்பதும், சேர்த்ததைக் காப்பதும், காத்த பொருளைப் பிரித்துச் செலவிடுவதும் ஆகிய செயல்களில் வல்லதே சிறந்த அரசாகும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the four essential economic duties of a ruler. First, 'இயற்றல்' means creating or facilitating sources of wealth. Second, 'ஈட்டல்' is the collection and accumulation of that wealth into the treasury. Third, 'காத்தல்' involves guarding the gathered wealth from loss, while 'வகுத்தல்' means properly distributing the protected wealth for the public good. A state is defined by its capability to perform all four of these sequential tasks effectively.
